### Extreme Networks Announces Investor Conferences for August and September 2026


August 6, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/756692490/files/doc_news/Extreme-Networks-Announces-Investor-Conferences-for-August-and-September-2026-2026.pdf)


MORRISVILLE, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Extreme Networks](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.extremenetworks.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3D25_PR_Aug-Sept-Conf-Sched_0000_CORP_AAD_REF_LPG_WW_EN_PRE_home%26utm_medium%3DReferral%26utm_source%3DPR-Aug-Sept-Conf-Sched%26utm_content%3Dhome&esheet=54585422&newsitemid=20260806020240&lan=en-US&anchor=Extreme+Networks&index=1&md5=b4bd9ca7d805c097355e284e00190aac) , Inc. (Nasdaq: EXTR), a leader in AI-powered automation for networking, today announced its investor conference schedule for August and September 2026:


- **KeyBanc Capital Markets Technology Leadership Forum** Kevin Rhodes, EVP and CFO
Park City, UT
Monday, August 10, 2026
1:30 p.m. MT


- **Oppenheimer 29th Annual Technology, Internet & Communications Conference** Stan Kovler, SVP, Finance and Corporate Development
Virtual
Tuesday, August 11, 2026
11:35 a.m. ET


- **Rosenblatt 6th Annual Age of AI Technology Summit** Ed Meyercord, President and CEO
Virtual
Monday, August 17, 2026
Conducting meetings throughout the day


- **Jefferies Semiconductor, IT Hardware & Communications Technology Conference** Kevin Rhodes, EVP and CFO
Chicago, IL
Tuesday, August 25, 2026
Conducting meetings throughout the day


- **Citi Global TMT Conference** Ed Meyercord, President and CEO
New York, NY
Wednesday, September 9, 2026
Conducting meetings throughout the day


- **B. Riley Consumer & TMT Conference** Ed Meyercord, President and CEO
New York, NY
Thursday, September 10, 2026
Conducting meetings throughout the day


- **Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference** Kevin Rhodes, EVP and CFO
Nashville, TN
Tuesday, September 15, 2026
Conducting meetings throughout the day


A live webcast from each fireside chat will be accessible under Events & Presentations on the Investor Relations section of the Extreme Networks website at[http://investor.extremenetworks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.extremenetworks.com&esheet=54585422&newsitemid=20260806020240&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.extremenetworks.com&index=2&md5=70f16edf46a2e75ab91888656dbd8a94) and will be archived for at least 30 days following the live presentation.


**About Extreme Networks:**


Extreme Networks, Inc. (EXTR) is a leader in AI-powered cloud networking, focused on delivering simple and secure solutions that help businesses address challenges and enable connections among devices, applications, and users. We push the boundaries of technology, leveraging the powers of artificial intelligence, analytics, and automation. Tens of thousands of customers globally trust our AI-powered cloud networking solutions and industry-leading support to enable businesses to drive value, foster innovation, and overcome extreme challenges. For more information, visit Extreme's website at[www.extremenetworks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.extremenetworks.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3D25_PR_Aug-Sept-Conf-Sched_0000_CORP_AAD_REF_LPG_WW_EN_PRE_home%26utm_medium%3DReferral%26utm_source%3DPR-Aug-Sept-Conf-Sched%26utm_content%3Dhome&esheet=54585422&newsitemid=20260806020240&lan=en-US&anchor=www.extremenetworks.com&index=3&md5=95defe667bb1e9d324e2cb2aeb600a07) or follow us on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fextreme-networks%2F&esheet=54585422&newsitemid=20260806020240&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=4&md5=23da8b3bc8cdec62a31182ab285c4b97) ,[YouTube](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fchannel%2FUCMtPKoR8ZCx9gdcDTqHj_iA%2Ffeed&esheet=54585422&newsitemid=20260806020240&lan=en-US&anchor=YouTube&index=5&md5=199ca8310b6d195c833a6dd1667e559e) ,[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fextremenetworks&esheet=54585422&newsitemid=20260806020240&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=6&md5=bec6d629b0a3fc7138d00af9a34b302c) ,[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fextremenetworks&esheet=54585422&newsitemid=20260806020240&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=7&md5=35a22b0f85cafdfb6e72713b6cfe7d90) , or[Instagram.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fextremenetworks%2F&esheet=54585422&newsitemid=20260806020240&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram.&index=8&md5=877ded1dbe4c75d2f9ff2ef027adecbe)
